summary: Independent read-only static review passed for all current tracked changes (engine.rs, phase6_verify.py, test_acceptance_harness.py, and tests_kernel/src/lib.rs) and the complete new write_preservation.rs and maintenance_measurements.rs files. The write optimization skips an old-block read only when every live old byte in that block is supplied by the overwrite; retained bytes, zero-filled gaps, truncated tails, padded CRC inputs, COW destinations, and existing commit/flush ordering remain intact. The write caller checks offset-plus-length overflow before entering change. The new ordinary regressions cover aligned/unaligned/full/partial overwrites, EOF/gap extension, every required preservation sector-read failure, remount recovery, and truncate/re-extension. The additional mutation-poisoning assertion is present at write_preservation.rs:131-133 and correctly requires a failed mutation after an earlier COW write to remain blocked until remount. Acceptance explicitly enables host-tools, selects the write_preservation integration target without ignored tests, requires three passing ordinary regressions and zero failures, and has mocked missing-test publication rejection coverage. Both maintenance measurements are ignored and included only under cfg(test); the allocator's existing cfg(test) address mirror makes their synthetic heap addresses appropriate for this host harness. Frame measurements use independent allocator instances and the heap measurement intentionally observes rather than mandates existing capacity loss. git diff --check completed successfully; Git emitted only LF-to-CRLF conversion warnings. No tests, builds, QEMU, or acceptance runs were executed under this review's read-only/no-build scope; this verdict is not runtime or release certification. No source files were modified.
